name: Decisions
overview: Scripture teaches that making decisions requires trusting in the Lord wholeheartedly rather than relying on our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 emphasizes. Facing tough decisions and trials is part of the Christian journey, and endurance through temptation and suffering is rewarded with the crown of life promised to those who love God (James 1:12; Revelation 2:10). Wise decisions are marked by faithfulness and reliance on God's guidance even in difficult circumstances.
